plan.planSummary: Implements the CiviCRM ETL migration feature (S06): two new audit tables (import_batch, import_row_result), a pure-function ETL services package (normalize/reader/mapper/loader/streaming_report/runner), a 5-endpoint admin read-only router, a CLI entrypoint with YAML column-map templates, and two read-only React admin pages with full nav/route wiring. The plan is built around four verified as-built reconciliations: (1) the live Alembic head is c1d2e3f4a5b6 (confirmed via `alembic heads`, not j4k5l6m7n8o9 as recon stated); (2) name_match.py exposes a module-level async match_name(...)->NameMatchResult TypedDict (string outcome 'SINGLE'/'AMBIGUOUS'/'UNMATCHED'), with NO MatchService class or MatchResult enum; (3) S05 bulk_upsert_participants(db, rows) returns an int rowcount, so bulk-inserted participants get entity_id=None; (4) Contact.external_id / Event.external_id are Integer columns, so the loader must coerce external_id strings to int. CRITICAL GAP DISCOVERED: NameMatchReviewQueue currently has NO raw_payload or source column and _enqueue_review() silently drops the payload arg that match_name accepts — so the migration must add raw_payload(JSONB) + source(String) columns to name_match_review_queue and wire _enqueue_review to persist payload, otherwise T06 links threading and T07's pending_review_count JSONB query both return 0. Test acceptance criteria from intake T09/T11 are folded into the engineerNotes of T04/T05/T06/T07/T08 (backend) and T10 (frontend) so the QA phase generates them; T09/T11 are not standalone tasks.

featureTasks.name: T01 — Alembic migration: import_batch + import_row_result tables + name_match_review_queue.raw_payload/source columns
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria:
1. New file backend/alembic/versions/<fresh_hex>_add_migration_etl_tables.py with revision=<fresh unique hex, NOT 'g4b5c6d7e8f9'> and down_revision='c1d2e3f4a5b6'.
2. upgrade() creates import_batch first (parent), then import_row_result (child).
3. import_batch has all 16 columns: id (Integer PK autoincrement), source_filename (String 512 nullable), entity (String 20 not null), mode (String 10 not null), status (String 20 not null default 'running'), column_map (JSONB not null), options (JSONB not null), total_rows/created_count/updated_count/skipped_count/error_count/review_count (Integer not null default 0), started_at (DateTime not null), finished_at (DateTime nullable), created_by_id (Integer FK users.id ON DELETE SET NULL nullable).
4. import_row_result has 9 columns: id (Integer PK), batch_id (Integer FK import_batch.id ON DELETE CASCADE not null), row_number (Integer not null), external_id (String 64 nullable), outcome (String 20 not null), entity_id (Integer nullable), message (Text nullable), raw (JSONB nullable), created_at (DateTime not null).
5. Indexes created: ix_import_batch_entity_status (entity,status), ix_import_batch_started_at (started_at), ix_import_row_result_batch (batch_id), ix_import_row_result_outcome (batch_id,outcome).
6. JSONB columns use _JSONB = sa.JSON().with_variant(postgresql.JSONB(astext_type=sa.Text()), 'postgresql') — never raw JSONB.
7. Adds two columns to existing name_match_review_queue: raw_payload (_JSONB nullable) and source (String 20 nullable), each guarded by an inspector check (insp.get_columns) so re-run is idempotent; add index ix_nmrq_source (source).
8. downgrade() drops import_row_result, then import_batch, then drops the two name_match_review_queue columns + ix_nmrq_source (all inspector-guarded).
9. All op.create_table / op.create_index / op.add_column wrapped in sa_inspect guards (existing-table/column/index checks) consistent with b1c2d3e4f5a6 pattern.
10. `alembic upgrade head` then `alembic downgrade -1` round-trips cleanly on Postgres CI (skipped on SQLite create_all path).
featureTasks.engineerNotes: Confirmed via `alembic heads`: live head is c1d2e3f4a5b6 (the recon's 'j4k5l6m7n8o9' is a non-head leaf; do not use it). Pick a fresh unique hex revision id — do NOT reuse the spec's illustrative 'g4b5c6d7e8f9'. Copy the inspector-guard + _JSONB alias pattern verbatim from backend/alembic/versions/b1c2d3e4f5a6_s22_name_matching_tables.py. CRITICAL ADDITION beyond intake: name_match_review_queue (created in b1c2d3e4f5a6) has NO raw_payload or source column today — verified in app/models.py lines 720-770. The whole links-phase design (T06) and pending_review_count query (T07) depend on raw_payload['batch_id'], so this migration MUST add raw_payload(JSONB nullable) + source(String 20 nullable) + ix_nmrq_source. Use postgresql.JSONB(astext_type=sa.Text()) explicitly so the .astext operator works in T07. from sqlalchemy.dialects import postgresql at top. Keep upgrade/downgrade column order parent-before-child / child-before-parent.

featureTasks.name: T02 — SQLAlchemy models: ImportBatch + ImportRowResult; add raw_payload/source to NameMatchReviewQueue
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria:
1. ImportBatch model in app/models.py with all 16 columns matching T01: id PK; source_filename String(512) nullable; entity String(20); mode String(10); status String(20) default='running'; column_map JSONB default=dict; options JSONB default=dict; total_rows/created_count/updated_count/skipped_count/error_count/review_count Integer default=0; started_at DateTime default=utc_now; finished_at DateTime nullable; created_by_id Integer FK users.id ON DELETE SET NULL nullable.
2. ImportRowResult model: id PK; batch_id Integer FK import_batch.id ON DELETE CASCADE; row_number Integer; external_id String(64) nullable; outcome String(20); entity_id Integer nullable; message Text nullable; raw JSONB nullable; created_at DateTime default=utc_now.
3. ImportBatch.__table_args__ mirrors migration indexes ix_import_batch_entity_status, ix_import_batch_started_at.
4. ImportRowResult.__table_args__ mirrors ix_import_row_result_batch, ix_import_row_result_outcome.
5. NameMatchReviewQueue gains raw_payload (Mapped[Optional[dict]] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=True)) and source (Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=True)) plus Index('ix_nmrq_source','source') appended to its __table_args__.
6. Uses the module-level JSONB alias (models.py line 26) — no re-import of PG JSONB. utc_now used for timestamp defaults. Mapped[...] / mapped_column 2.0 style throughout, type-hinted.
7. After this change, `pytest tests/ -q` collects without import errors and Base.metadata.create_all builds both new tables under SQLite.
featureTasks.engineerNotes: Follow the existing PhotoIngestBatch / ExportJob model patterns already in models.py. Reuse module-level JSONB alias (line 26) and utc_now() (line 30) — do NOT re-import postgresql JSONB. external_id on ImportRowResult is String(64) even though Contact.external_id/Event.external_id are Integer — that's intentional (it holds the raw source token string); the loader (T05) coerces to int when querying. Place ImportBatch before ImportRowResult so the FK target class is defined first. Adding raw_payload/source to NameMatchReviewQueue keeps the ORM in sync with T01 so SQLite create_all and the T07 query agree. conftest imports app.main eagerly which imports app.models, so these classes must be importable before any create_all runs.

featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria:

4. write_people_link(session, source_contact_id, field_name, resolved_contact_id) does an idempotent custom_data JSONB merge (skip if field already set) and wraps an audit_service.record() call in try/except so a missing audit_log table never crashes.
5. streaming_report.py: async def stream_batch_csv(batch_id, session) uses db.stream(...) with execution_options(yield_per=...) / max_row_buffer-style partitioning; yields a CSV header line then one line per ImportRowResult ordered by row_number; never accumulates all rows in RAM.

7. No router imports.

featureTasks.name: T06 — Migration services package: runner.py phase orchestrator + wire _enqueue_review to persist payload/source
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria:
1. async def run_phase(phase, xlsx_path, column_map, options, dry_run, created_by_id, db_factory) -> int returns the batch_id.
2. Creates ImportBatch status='running' and commits BEFORE reading any rows.
3. Preflight (contacts phase): validates every custom_data.* target exists in CustomFieldDef; on failure raises/handles BatchFatalError -> batch.status='failed', commit, re-raise; zero core-table rows written.
4. Participants phase pre-loads {external_id->app_id} dicts for contacts and events before iterating rows.
5. Links phase: for each row, reads the source contact via contact_external_id, skips the field if custom_data[field_name] already set, else calls await match_name(raw_name=..., db=db, source='migration', payload={'batch_id':batch_id,'field_name':field_name,'source_contact_id':contact_app_id}); if result['outcome']=='SINGLE' -> write_people_link; 'AMBIGUOUS'/'UNMATCHED' -> ImportRowResult outcome='review' (match_name already enqueued the review row).
6. Rows buffered and flushed in chunks of 500 (contacts/events) / 1000 (participants).
7. dry_run=True wraps core writes in a savepoint (begin_nested) that rolls back, while ImportBatch + ImportRowResult rows are committed on a separate path so the batch is UI-inspectable.
8. After all rows: tally counts from ImportRowResult, set status='completed' + finished_at, commit.
9. CN-24: after a successful LIVE run only, attempt `from app.services import member_status_service` inside try/except ImportError and call recompute_all_contacts(db); skip silently if absent.
10. On any exception: status='failed', finished_at set, commit, re-raise.
11. _enqueue_review in name_match.py is updated to accept and persist the payload dict into NameMatchReviewQueue.raw_payload and set source from the match_name source arg; match_name passes payload + source through to _enqueue_review for both AMBIGUOUS and UNMATCHED branches.
featureTasks.filesToChange: backend/app/services/migration/runner.py (new), backend/app/services/name_match.py (modify _enqueue_review + its two call sites in match_name)
featureTasks.engineerNotes: VERIFIED against name_match.py (lines 642-745): match_name is a module-level async fn match_name(raw_name, db, source, event_id=None, community_report_id=None, payload=None, auto_enqueue=True) -> NameMatchResult (TypedDict, outcome is a string). There is NO MatchService class and NO MatchResult enum — ignore the spec's runner.py sketch entirely. CRITICAL: today _enqueue_review (lines 595-636) does NOT receive or store payload — it builds NameMatchReviewQueue WITHOUT raw_payload/source. You MUST (a) add raw_payload=payload and source=source to the NameMatchReviewQueue(...) constructor in _enqueue_review, and (b) thread payload+source from match_name into both _enqueue_review call sites. Without this, T07's pending_review_count is always 0 and the 'Review People Links' button never appears. Keep this change minimal and backward-compatible (payload defaults None). member_status_service guard is try/except ImportError (NOT AttributeError) — S23 has not landed. Use db_factory (app.database.async_session) for sessions; never import any router (CN-25). FOLDED QA TESTS (intake T09 links subset, QA phase authors): test_migration_links.py — 5 async tests that monkeypatch/patch app.services.name_match.match_name (the real function, NOT MatchService.resolve): SINGLE -> link written, AMBIGUOUS -> review outcome + queue row, UNMATCHED -> review outcome, re-run protection (already-set field skipped), and assert batch_id present in the persisted raw_payload. recon.patterns:
1. ALEMBIC MIGRATIONS: All migrations use inspector guards (sa_inspect + insp.get_table_names() / get_columns()) for idempotency. Cross-dialect JSONB: `_JSONB = sa.JSON().with_variant(PG_JSONB(), "postgresql")`. revision/down_revision declared as module-level strings. Indexes created with op.create_index, guarded by checking existing_indexes set.

2. ORM MODELS: All in app/models.py, inheriting from Base (declarative_base). Use Mapped[T] + mapped_column() (SQLAlchemy 2.0 style). JSONB columns use module-level JSONB alias. utc_now() for all timestamp defaults (returns naive UTC datetime). __table_args__ tuple for indexes and constraints. ForeignKey with ondelete= always specified.

3. PYDANTIC SCHEMAS: All in app/schemas.py. Response schemas have ConfigDict(from_attributes=True). All fields typed with Optional[T] = None pattern. Validators use @field_validator / @model_validator. List fields use List[T] = []. Pagination pattern: PaginatedXxxResponse with {total, page, page_size, items}.

4. ROUTERS: One file per domain in app/routers/. Each file has a module-level docstring listing endpoints. Imports: get_db, require_admin/require_volunteer from dependencies, models from app.models, schemas from app.schemas, services from app.services.*. APIRouter with prefix and tags. Registered in main.py with dependencies=[Depends(check_setup_complete)] except setup.py and auth.py.

5. SERVICES: Pure async functions, no class wrappers (except where legacy — e.g. ComprefaceClient). Circular-import rule: services never import routers. Services import only app.models, app.database, sqlalchemy, stdlib, and other services. Audit writes via audit_svc.record() after primary mutation flush.

6. ASYNC DB PATTERN: async with async_session() as session, or injected via get_db(). await db.execute(select(...)), result.scalars().all() or result.all(). Streaming: db.stream(stmt.execution_options(yield_per=1000)) + async for partition in result.partitions(1000).

7. UPSERT PATTERN (bulk_service.py): Dialect-branched insert: pg_insert(Model) / sqlite_insert(Model), .on_conflict_do_update() for pg / .on_conflict_do_nothing() for sqlite. Engine dialect checked via _app_engine.dialect.name.

8. FRONTEND SERVICES: One file per domain in frontend/src/services/. All use the shared api (axios instance from api.ts with /api baseURL and Bearer interceptor). Functions are async, return typed data directly (resp.data). Error surfacing via err.response?.data?.detail in toast.

9. FRONTEND TYPES: Core types in frontend/src/types/index.ts. Domain-specific types in separate files (nameMatch.ts, bulk.ts, customFields.ts). TypeScript interfaces, not type aliases for objects. Paginated<T> generic used.

10. FRONTEND TESTS: Vitest + @testing-library/react. Test files in frontend/src/__tests__/ or co-located with component. Pattern: vi.mock('@/services/xxx'), render in MemoryRouter + QueryClientProvider, screen.getBy* assertions, waitFor for async. Setup in frontend/src/test/setup.ts.

11. AUTH/ROLES: require_admin for admin-only endpoints, require_volunteer for volunteer+admin, require_viewer for all authenticated. AdminRoute component for admin-only frontend pages. Access token in-memory (Zustand authStore), refresh via HttpOnly cookie.

12. NAMING: snake_case Python everywhere. camelCase TypeScript. Router files named after domain (community_reports.py, not communityReports.py). Test files named test_{domain}.py. Frontend pages named {Domain}Page.tsx.

2. MIGRATION HEAD — T01 must set down_revision="j4k5l6m7n8o9" (the S04 migration). Any agent that generates a migration must read the current head from the alembic/versions directory first, as the chain is: 74e9ab60ea7e → a1b2c3d4e5f6 → a2b3c4d5e6f7 → b1c2d3e4f5a6 → b3c4d5e6f7a8 → c1d2e3f4a5b6 → c5d6e7f8a9b0 → d1e2f3a4b5c6 → e2f3a4b5c6d7 → f3a4b5c6d7e8 → g7h8i9j0k1l2 → h1i2j3k4l5m6 → i3j4k5l6m7n8 → j4k5l6m7n8o9 (current head).

3. MODEL REGISTRATION — T02 adds ORM models; they must be imported before any test calls Base.metadata.create_all(). The conftest.py imports app.main eagerly (line 32) which triggers all router imports and thus all model imports. The new ImportBatch and ImportRowResult classes must be importable via app.models before conftest runs.

4. CIRCULAR IMPORT — The migration services package (T04-T06) must not import from any router module (CN-25 rule enforced throughout the codebase). runner.py must import only from app.models, app.database, app.services.*, and stdlib.

5. DIALECT-SAFE UPSERT — T05's upsert_contact and upsert_event must use the same pg_insert/sqlite_insert dual-dialect pattern as bulk_service.py (lines 27-29). The Participant table has a UniqueConstraint on (event_id, contact_id); bulk_insert_participants must respect it.

6. ROUTER REGISTRATION ORDER (P03) — main.py line 135 is `app.include_router(storage_router.router)` without check_setup_complete. The migration router must be inserted before that line (after community_reports_router at line 134), with Depends(check_setup_complete). Wrong placement could cause auth bypass or 503 loops.

7. JSONB COLUMN ALIAS — T01 migration must use the `_JSONB = sa.JSON().with_variant(PG_JSONB(), "postgresql")` pattern (not raw PG_JSONB()) for SQLite test compatibility. T02 ORM models must use the module-level `JSONB` alias.

8. CN-24 MEMBER STATUS RECOMPUTE — T06 runner.py references a nightly recompute job (CN-24). The existing codebase has no services/backfill-style recompute for member status (the snapshot columns are documented as "populated by S23 nightly job"). If no recompute service exists yet, T06 must either stub this call or make it optional.

9. FRONTEND ROUTE GUARD — T10 migration pages must be wrapped in AdminRoute (not ProtectedRoute) since they are admin-only. The AdminRoute component redirects non-admins to /.

10. TEST DB SCHEMA COVERAGE — T09 tests use the shared db_session fixture which calls Base.metadata.create_all. ImportBatch and ImportRowResult models (T02) must be registered on Base before tests run. If T02 is not implemented before T09, create_all will skip those tables and FK-dependent tests will fail.
